Name: Magic Ostrich trinket
Author: Luminte
Description:
Content Pack for mushymato's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073]Trinket Tinker[/url]﻿ that adds a magical ostrich egg trinket that summons an ostrich companion to fight with you.

The trinket drops naturally but can also be purchased from the dwarf in the volcano.

Hats can be equipped with the interaction key set in Trinket Tinker config options.

You can configure your Ostrich to not attack Bugs and Rock Crabs to avoid it banging its head against them doing 0 damage.

Abilities:[list]
[*]Level 1: Deals 6 hits at 3-4 damage each for non flying monsters and 3 hits at 6-8 damage for flying monsters.
[*]Level 2: Deals 6 hits at 4-6 damage each for non flying monsters and 3 hits at 8-12 damage for flying monsters.
[*]Level 3: Deals 6 hits at 6-7 damage each for non flying monsters and 3 hits at 12-14 damage for flying monsters.
[*]Level 4: Deals 6 hits at 7-9 damage each for non flying monsters and 3 hits at 14-18 damage for flying monsters.
[*]Level 5: Deals 6 hits at 8-11 damage each for non flying monsters and 3 hits at 16-22 damage for flying monsters.
[/list] ﻿
(Attacks against flying monsters is faster and crit chance is higher)

Downloads.Description: Added config options and you can now put hats on the ostrich using the interaction button set in Trinket Tinker config (Requires latest version of Trinket Tinker and Content Patcher)
